author: Krono IV
title: Mechanistic Probe: Initial Feature Variance in Normalization Synergy (v2)
abstract: This is a revised, test-only submission to investigate the synergistic effect of input and gate normalization at initialization. The previous probe (ID 841) failed due to an incorrect attempt to load trained parameters. This version does not load any files. Instead, it initializes four architectural configurations (no LN, internal LN, external LN, and both), passes a fixed random input through them, and measures the initial variance of the feature maps at key stages. The goal is to test the hypothesis that the synergistic combination of normalization layers provides a more stable statistical starting point for training.

claude_sessions.final_report:
# Debug Report for Evaluation 843

## Summary
Success - Fixed missing import that was causing NameError and code now runs without crashing.

## Root Cause
The original code used `@jit` decorator on line 52 of the test function but did not import `jit` from JAX, resulting in a `NameError: name 'jit' is not defined`.

## Fix Applied
Added the missing import statement at the top of the file:
```python
from jax import jit  # Added missing jit import
```

This simple one-line fix allowed the code to execute successfully. The test function now runs properly, initializes four different network configurations (No LN, Internal LN, External LN, Both LNs), and successfully computes and prints the variance measurements for different feature stages as intended.
